headline: Akbank reports total lending exceeds 3 trillion Turkish liras
summary: Akbank announced its total lending reached 3.035 trillion Turkish liras during the first nine months of the year, including cash loans.
why: Loan volume expansion is a primary driver of net interest income and overall profitability for commercial banks.

impacts.name: Akbank
impacts.why: Higher lending volumes support core interest income growth for the Turkish commercial bank.
